kashika: तस्येत्संज्ञकस्य लोपो भवति। तथा चैवोदाहृतम्। तस्यग्रहणं सर्वलोपार्थम्। अलोऽन्त्यस्य मा भूत् — <<आदिर्ञिटुडवः>> [[१.३.५]] इति॥
kashikaEnglish: Indicatory letters (it) are elided—they mark grammatical properties but don't appear in the final form.
englishShort: The इत् letter is elided during the प्रक्रिया.
englishFull:
इत् letters are elided.

Indicatory letters serve only as markers and are deleted in the final form.

The word तस्य indicates the entire इत् unit is replaced by लोप (zero), not just its final letter (@ref[1.1.52]). So ञि, टु, डु are wholly deleted, not just their finals.
